body.表面涂层 Painting Color: 德国劳尔色标RAL 7046（银灰色环氧树脂），阀体材质为不锈钢时，本体部不加涂层 / RAL 7046 is standard. In the case of stainless steel body, no painting is standard.

actuator.用途 Purpose: 调节、开关 Modulation or On-Off
actuator.作用方式 Action Type: 随输入定位器信号增加阀开或阀闭。/ Valve open or shut by air or electric signal.

accessories.气动执行机构控制附件 Pneumatic Actuator Control Ac: 电气、气气、智能定位器，过滤减压阀，电磁阀，限位开关，调速器/增速器，锁止阀等等。/ E/P·P/P·Smart-Positioner, Air-set, Solenoid valve, Limit switch, Speed controller, Lock valve, Lock-up valve, etc.
accessories.电动执行机构控制附件 Electric Actuator Accessories: 加热器，控制箱，手轮机构等。/ Space heater, Junction box, Manual handle, etc.

special_options.本体特殊检查 Special Testing for Body: 材料检查，液体渗透探伤检查（PT），放射线检查（RT），流量特性检查，低温试验，蒸汽试验。/ Material certificate, Liquid penetrant testing, Radiographic testing, Flow characteristic testing, Low temperature testing, Steam testing.
special_options.本体特殊清洗 Cleaning for Body: 氧气清洁，完全禁油，除水处理。/ Oxygen clean, Oil-free, Water-free.
special_options.本体及执行机构特殊规格 Special Specification for Bo: 防砂，防尘型，防盐腐蚀型，无铜处理，特殊空气配管及特殊气接头，真空工作条件用，接触大气部分的螺栓、螺母采用不锈钢，指定涂层色，NACE处理，阀内件特殊设计，阀内件特殊材质。/ Sand and Dust proof, Salty environment proof, Tropical area proof, Copper-free alloy, Special piping and fitting, Vacuum service proof, SUS bolt and nut for exposed parts, Non-standard painting.
special_options.认证 Authorization: 各种认证 / All kinds of certifications
